parsed.text: Panel p0 contains fallible location distributions over 4×4 local grids for red and blue at nodes n0–n3. Current distributions are archived/inherited snapshots (represented_time 12, archived_origin_time 13) and are not new estimates; candidate records (commands k0, k1, k2) are conditional native records (represented_time 13) and are not events that have actually occurred. Current, panel p0: at n0 red mass concentrates on the top-left 2×2 cells and blue mass concentrates on the top-right 2×2 cells; at n1–n3 both red and blue distributions are uniform across all 16 cells. Candidate k0 matches the n0 concentrations for p0 and leaves n1–n3 uniform. Candidate k1 makes n0 uniform (as do n1–n3). Candidate k2 makes n0 sharply peaked for blue at cell [0,2] and for red at [0,0], while n1–n3 remain uniform. Differences across candidate views are limited to n0; other nodes retain uniform distributions in all candidates.
